# Application tour captures

The video frames the screenshots in an illustrated Safari window. The address bar shows the corresponding Antalos service. Upstream application screens show the projects’ example data.

- Authentik and Grafana use the portfolio’s existing dashboard captures.
- Argo CD uses the [Antalos documentation capture](https://github.com/antblu/antalos/blob/main/docs/images/argocd-dash.png).
- Vaultwarden shows the public [sign-in screen](https://vault.antblu.net).
